blind.description: A stylized wooden coffin or casket constructed from dark brown longitudinal wood planks. It features a classic tapered hexagonal coffin profile (wider at the shoulders and narrower at the head and foot). Two thick coiled ropes wrap tightly around the lid and body, each finished with central knots. Small rounded silver metal studs or rivets are positioned along the outer perimeter of the lid. The surface is clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted wood grain texture.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as an elongated, symmetrical hexagonal coffin lid made of three central wooden planks, bounded by two thick horizontal rope bands and dotted with silver rivets along the top and bottom corners and shoulders.
blind.height_vs_figure: Lying flat on the ground, it stands about 1.5 feet high (around a quarter of the scale figure's height), roughly 5.5 to 6 feet long (matching the figure's height), and approximately 2 feet wide at its widest section.
